Taking part is voluntary. You may refuse to participate or leave the study at any time without penalty or loss of benefits to which you are otherwise entitled. Tell the study doctor or study staff if you decide to leave. Discuss with the study doctor whether any follow-up care or testing would help evaluate side effects or other medical problems. Information collected before withdrawal may continue to be used as permitted by this consent and applicable requirements.

To stop participating, tell or write to your enrolling site coordinator. Staff offer an optional discussion of symptoms and ordinary-care needs. You do not have to have a final research examination, extra tests or further data collection after withdrawal. The investigator may end participation at your request, if you cannot complete assessments, if you have additional eye surgery or if the study stops; staff record the reason when available. Earned payments and eligible travel expenses already incurred remain due under the payment terms in this form.

Tell or write to your enrolling site coordinator using the contact section to stop participation. A final clinical discussion is optional; no final research measurement or extra contact is required. The investigator may end participation at your request, if assessments cannot be completed or if the study closes. Staff record reasons when available. A later change in usual glaucoma medicines alone is not a reason to stop participation. You retain payment already earned without finishing every contact, and there is no completion bonus. A started but unfinished contact earns half its payment. If you leave after the telephone contact, the clinic offers payment pickup within 14 days without another research visit. Amounts and collection arrangements are in the payment section.
